root.label: C++20 coroutines & generator
root.note: Compiler-generated stackless state machines pause and resume without separate OS thread stacks.

children.label: Stackless frame mechanics
children.note: Compiler transforms functions containing co_await, co_yield, or co_return into frames.

children.label: Frame stores spilled locals
children.note: Holds promise, copied parameters, suspension index, and cross-suspend variables.

children.label: Custom operator new & HALO
children.note: Promises may override allocation; compilers elide heap frames when lifetimes nest.

children.label: Runs on resumer thread
children.note: Calling or resuming a coroutine executes synchronously on the invoking thread.

children.label: Promise lifecycle
children.note: coroutine_traits<R, Args...>::promise_type orchestrates startup, returns, and teardown.

children.label: initial_suspend laziness
children.note: Returns suspend_always for lazy start or suspend_never for eager execution.

children.label: final_suspend must be noexcept
children.note: Suspending lets RAII wrappers call destroy(); suspend_never self-deletes the frame.

children.label: unhandled_exception hook
children.note: Captures uncaught body exceptions inside the promise before final_suspend runs.

children.label: Awaitable protocol
children.note: co_await drives await_transform, await_ready, await_suspend, and await_resume.

children.label: await_ready bypass
children.note: Returns true when results are already ready, avoiding suspension overhead.

children.label: Symmetric transfer handle
children.note: Returning coroutine_handle<> from await_suspend tail-resumes without stack growth.

children.label: Suspended before await_suspend
children.note: Another thread can resume and destroy h immediately once await_suspend publishes h.

children.label: Suspension lifetime hazards
children.note: References and closure captures outlive temporaries across suspension boundaries.

children.label: Reference & view parameters
children.note: const T& and string_view bind temporaries that die at the caller semicolon.

children.label: Lambda capture closure trap
children.note: Temporary coroutine lambdas destroy captures at the semicolon, leaving dangling this.

children.label: Pass owning values
children.note: By-value parameters move directly into the coroutine frame for safe later access.

children.label: C++23 std::generator
children.note: Standard synchronous ranges::view backed by co_yield and promise.yield_value.

children.label: co_yield lowers to co_await
children.note: Every co_yield x evaluates co_await promise.yield_value(x).

children.label: elements_of O(1) recursion
children.note: Yielding nested generators via elements_of avoids linear trampoline overhead.
